intro: Trying to find Connecticut scholarships for high school students in the USA usually means sorting through programs that look similar at first glance but differ in who can apply, what materials they ask for, and how awards are described. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings tied to Connecticut and the high school theme, with rows spanning areas like education, community, arts, STEM, and medicine. Some opportunities may fit current high school students directly, while others need a closer read on study level or residency wording. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirement details are not identical, so it is worth comparing each row carefully before you apply.
